```sql
with periods as (
    select 'this_month' as key,
           date '2026-09-01' as start_date,
           date '2026-09-09' as end_date,
           1 as ord
    union all
    select 'last_month' as key,
           date '2026-08-01' as start_date,
           date '2026-08-09' as end_date,
           2 as ord
),
fx as (
    select c.rate_date,
           c.currency,
           cast(c.usd_per_unit / r.usd_per_unit as decimal(38,12)) as to_reporting
    from fx_rates c
    join fx_rates r
      on r.rate_date = c.rate_date
     and r.currency = 'INR'
),
captures as (
    select a.attempt_id,
           a.order_id,
           a.amount_minor,
           a.currency,
           a.business_date,
           row_number() over (
               partition by a.order_id, a.amount_minor
               order by a.attempt_no, a.attempt_id
           ) as capture_rank
    from payment_attempts a
    join orders o on o.order_id = a.order_id
    join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
    where a.status = 'captured'
      and not a.is_test
      and not o.is_test
      and s.region_id in ('IN-TN')
)
select p.key,
       cast(coalesce(round(sum(c.amount_minor * fx.to_reporting)), 0) as bigint) as value
from periods p
left join captures c
  on c.business_date between p.start_date and p.end_date
 and c.capture_rank = 1
left join fx
  on fx.currency = c.currency
 and fx.rate_date = c.business_date
group by p.key, p.ord
order by p.ord
```
